description: Source code for executing and resolving paths for Git commands, including platform-specific methods for determining the executable path and setting up environment variables and command execution.

methods.name: system_prefix
methods.description: Determines the system prefix path, either dynamically or fallback.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_from_argv0
methods.description: Resolves executable path from argv[0] if absolute.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_procfs
methods.description: Resolves executable path via procfs symlink.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_bsd_sysctl
methods.description: Resolves executable path using BSD sysctl.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_darwin
methods.description: Resolves executable path on Darwin systems.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_zos
methods.description: Resolves executable path on z/OS systems.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path
methods.description: Determines the absolute executable path using multiple platform-specific methods.

methods.name: git_resolve_executable_dir
methods.description: Resolves and sets the directory of the current executable.

methods.name: system_path
methods.description: Constructs a system path, adding prefix if necessary.

methods.name: git_set_exec_path
methods.description: Sets the executable path and propagates it to environment.

methods.name: git_exec_path
methods.description: Returns the highest-priority path for Git programs.

methods.name: add_path
methods.description: Adds a path to a strbuf, normalizing it.

methods.name: setup_path
methods.description: Sets up the environment PATH variable for Git.

methods.name: prepare_git_cmd
methods.description: Prepares command arguments for executing Git.

methods.name: execv_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes a Git command with given arguments.

methods.name: execl_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes a Git command with variable arguments.
